description: A gotogether span conversion rule file (gotogether.convert/1): which OpenTelemetry spans or span events become which model steps. Generated from the Go type that reads it (GOTOGETHER_UPDATE_SCHEMA=1 go test ./schemas/).

actor.description: Defaults applied to every rule that does not set them.

format.description: Format, if set, names the rule file's format (FormatName, gotogether.convert/1): a later major is refused with the fix, not with its new keys "unknown". Empty: gotogether.convert/1.

recorder.description: Recorder groups steps for numbering: an expression; default resource:service.instance.id, else resource:service.name.

ref.description: Ref, an expression, is each step's link to its artifact (qtrace.Step.Ref): "attr:app.screenshot", "=trace.jsonl". A span (or matched event) carrying quint.ref keeps it when no rule sets one.

drop.description: Drop: matched spans produce no step (and stop later rules matching them).

event.description: if set, match the span's events of this name instead of the span

where.description: attribute filters: attr:K semantics, string equality ("*" = present)

title: gotogether span conversion rules
